tae: Quick heads-up from onboarding: people keep copying direct status checks (if err.status === 429). Can we converge on tiny typed errors + a retry_hint contract?

anita: Yes. Proposal: SDKs expose RateLimitError, AuthError, PermissionError, ServerError, ClientError. Each error includes httpStatus, rawBody, headers, plus retryHint enum (no-retry|retry-after|exponential|refresh-token) and retryAfter (seconds|null).

rob: For Go, add interface methods RetryHint() string and RetryAfter() time.Duration and helpers IsRetryable(err error) bool and RetryAfterOrDefault(err error, d time.Duration) time.Duration. Parse Retry-After both as seconds and HTTP-date; treat 0 as immediate retry.

zhou: Platform should prefer sending a small envelope: {code, message, http_status, retry_hint?}. If retry_hint present, SDK should prefer it over header heuristics. Also include support_id in metadata for debugging.

ci-bot: ci/go-sdk #1602 failed: tests/retry_test.go:8 -> expected retry_hint "retry-after" but got "none". Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/go-sdk/1602

taе: I'll open a tiny PR to export RateLimitError in go-sdk, implement Retry-After parsing and add tests for numeric/HTTP-date/0 forms. Will also add a sample-app snippet showing idiomatic retry pattern.

anita: Once merged, update quickstarts to show instanceof/except/IsRetryable usage and add a linter in sample-apps to flag direct numeric status checks. Small change but big onboarding win. :rocket:
